raw_response: {"diagnosis": "From batch 3 onward, each delivery holds late-arriving but unique POSTED transactions, with txn_ts up to about 3 days before ingest_ts. The hard-coded 26-hour lateness filter in silver_transactions silently drops about 25% of each batch. txn_id is unique across all 4827 raw rows, so these are genuine transactions, and the RAW_TO_SILVER monitor expects them in silver.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.62, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED'"}}
